Name: Jehonadab, Son of Rechab
Summary: Jehonadab, son of Rechab, met Jehu on the road, gave him his hand, rode with him to Samaria, and witnessed Jehu's purge of Baal's worshippers.
KeyStory: Jehonadab rides with Jehu against Baal.
RelatedPeople: Jehu, King of Israel; Rechab, Father of Jehonadab
LifeLesson: A man of the desert can steady a king's zeal, and also see where it stops.
